results_section.claim: 1. Sparsity varies significantly from 3.2 (Lasso) to 7.2 (Ridge) components on average
results_section.explanation: Analysis stage: The stored decomposition_results_analysis.json clearly shows Lasso overall sparsity mean=0.944 (std=1.012) and Ridge overall sparsity mean=8.0 (std=0.0). The paper's own Table 1 (claims 9 and 18) also reports Ridge=8.0±0.0 and Lasso=0.9±1.0. Neither 3.2 for Lasso nor 7.2 for Ridge appears in any stored results (by_algorithm, by_category, by_algorithm_by_category, or by_algorithm_by_category_by_merging_method). Even for known-category only, lasso_known sparsity=1.875 and ridge_known=8.0. The PHASE4_DECOMPOSITON_TABLES.md also confirms: lasso=0.94 and ridge=8.00. The text claim 3.2 and 7.2 conflict with all stored data and with the paper's own table claims.
results_section.evidence: 176_UNMERGE_Verifiable_Model_C_Supplementary Material/results/decomposition_results_analysis.json (by_algorithm: lasso sparsity mean=0.9444, ridge sparsity mean=8.0); 176_UNMERGE_Verifiable_Model_C_Supplementary Material/PHASE4_DECOMPOSITON_TABLES.md (lasso sparsity=0.94, ridge sparsity=8.00)
